scope: Site copy verified against public v1.37.0 on October 18, 2026: tab group colors and the group menu, ungrouped tabs above, between and below groups, and links from grouped tabs opening ungrouped, on /features/tab-groups and its support guide. Also a shorter hero on that page (owner request). Replaces the v1.27 wording that groups have no colors and that links join their group. Also, at the owner's request, shorter hero ledes on nine feature pages and a shorter Sync heading.

groupColors.qualification: A group may carry one of the eight Spaces preset colors or none, off by default, chosen from the group menu; the color tints the group's block in the ⌘L panel and side list, adds a dot before its name and colors its tabs' Island dots. Desktop only (#936).

groupMenu.qualification: Right-clicking a group header or pressing its ⋮ opens one menu with the name field, the colors, New Tab in Group, Move Group to New Window, Ungroup and Close Group (#936). Move Group to New Window is covered by desktop scenarios but wasn't hand-checked on Linux before release, so the site names it without claiming a platform check.

ungroupedPlacement.qualification: Since v1.37.0 a window's tab order is its drawn order: ungrouped tabs can be dragged or moved with ⌥⇧↑/↓ above, between or below groups, each run is its own section for ⌘1–9, and new tabs still land at the bottom (#933).

linkChildren.qualification: Link children (target=_blank, window.open, Open Link in New Tab, Open Link in Glance) open ungrouped at the end of the tab order, like a plain new tab; private and opener relationships are unchanged (#928).

namedGroups.qualification: Named groups are user-created through /group or the tab menu; the resting Island shows the active group's tabs and other groups can be folded in the ⌘L panel. Blanc does not create or name groups by itself.

heroOnePassword.qualification: Explicit-invoke fill from the user's installed 1Password app through the Blanc Credential Broker; off by default, unavailable on Windows on Arm (the page's availability line is unchanged).

heroGlance.qualification: Glance shows another open tab beside the main page in a resizable split; the reference pane can be read alongside.

heroGestures.qualification: Mouse gestures are off by default; with them on, holding the gesture button and drawing a direction over the page runs that direction's assigned action, such as Back or New Tab.

heroProfiles.qualification: Local profiles keep Favorites, history, downloads metadata, permissions and site sessions separate per profile, created on the device with no account.

heroQuietTabs.qualification: An eligible idle background tab gives back its renderer; it keeps its place in the tab order and reloads when activated.

heroSecurity.qualification: The page describes blocking, the permission and runtime policy, and data handling; the lede introduces those sections.

heroSync.qualification: Opt-in end-to-end-encrypted sync of Favorites and settings, set up once per device; open-tab sharing is a separate, off-by-default switch.

heroBlocking.qualification: Blanc Blocker compiles bundled, hash-verified EasyList and EasyPrivacy snapshots; the Island's shield opens per-site controls.

heroSpaces.qualification: Spaces are switched from the Island's space mark; a bound space saves its tabs and groups and restores them after a restart.
